# Connect Convex project (`connect_convex_project`)

MCP tool `vault_convex_connectExistingProject` · scope `access_app_create` · write

Attaches an existing Convex project from `list_convex_projects` to a stable vault app. Samebase
stores the project identity only. Production, development, and preview deployments remain
provider-owned children and are read from Convex when a relevant view opens.

## Arguments

- `vaultId` (string, required): Samebase vault id of the app to attach the Convex project to.
- `appId` (string, required): Stable Samebase vault app id returned by get_user_vaults.
- `projectId` (string, required): Convex project id from list_convex_projects.

## Returns

The reply is confirmation text only; the tool sets no `structuredContent`.
